_eligibility_text: 1. An individual may open an account 1. An individual may also open one account on behalf of each minor or a person with mental illness or intellectual disability of whom he is the guardian: Provided that only one account shall be opened in the name of a minor or a person with mental illness or intellectual disability by any of the guardian. **Note:** Joint account shall not be opened under this Scheme **Note:** Accounts can also be opened through e-Banking facility. It is to be noted that Post Office Savings Account is a prerequisite for availing internet banking facility (Please visit www.ebanking.indiapost.gov.in)
